3. Saturday weekly count and return

Count at the depot or plant that issued the stock. POS quantity is net of returns and voids for this same week and request; it is a cross-check, not a physical count. Reasons are free text for discussion; no reason list has been approved.

Amounts are unavailable when counts or price are missing, the result is negative, or centavos require a rounding rule. Negative quantity differences require investigation, not automatic write-off. Never total mixed product quantities.

Net POS sales can differ because of pricing, discounts, returns, voids, credit and taxes. This comparison is not proof of cash collected or remitted; reconcile those separately.
